observations.body: At the Mount of Olives Jesus tells the disciples to pray against entering temptation, prays about the cup and the Father’s will, and finds them sleeping from sorrow.
observations.label: Prayer near arrest returns to temptation language

observations.body: The passage presents Praying, kneeling, strengthening, sleeping, and rising as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Praying, kneeling, strengthening, sleeping, and rising

observations.body: The passage places The Mount of Olives beside Praying, kneeling, strengthening, sleeping, and rising.
observations.label: The Mount of Olives

payload.posture: Read Luke 22:39–46 as one movement in the temptation of Jesus, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: Desired removal and the Father’s will
payload.title: Prayer near arrest returns to temptation language
